creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Kan migrates an older project before running any command, so a read such as `kan list` can leave a repo dirty. Reads also create a missing `.kan/config.toml` and rewrite an existing one. A query across 40 boards would dirty every repo with an older schema. Reported as feedback: "a read-only 'kan list' migrates an older board".

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Read commands never write inside a project". Reads transform older schemas in memory through the same functions `kan migrate` uses; the global config may still be written; `doctor` keeps reading raw files; `kan serve` still migrates the project it opens.

After a_2naKEczaZ.
title: Stop read commands from writing inside a project
